interface.shortDescription: Evidence Lane 2.2.0 - 83 native actions (26 read / 57 write) - 17 governed skills.
interface.longDescription: Evidence Lane is human-governed project memory for Codex. It preserves exact source, evidence, Delta, task, candidate, and accepted-version identity across long-running work. Evidence Lane 2.2.0 is the current pre-HIL Codex source release on the governed v2.2 branch; it is not an installed-host claim until the later exact-commit CI, preview, package, and same-selector installation route passes. The accepted/base GitLane release remains 2.1.0, and the disabled fallback host surface was observed at 2.0.0 pending its separately governed split-brain correction. This package carries seventeen governed skills and one package-local native MCP server named evidence-lane with eighty-three canonical actions: twenty-six read-only and fifty-seven write-capable. It supports Source Intake, Build, Refresh, pointer-only Rollback, exact-APPROVE Fuse, State Travel, Canon task exchange, project-isolated AI Learning, Mode, local durable storage, plugin administration, panels, search, diff, and governed Git evidence while keeping candidate acceptance human-controlled. Historical Git, package, and PV receipts remain immutable archive evidence. Google Drive is a separately named and authorized connector, never the Evidence Lane MCP, lifecycle proof, namespace owner, or durable local project authority. Codex lifecycle evidence must come from the package-local native server, never codex_apps, plugin-runtime, generated namespaces, direct-stdio fallback, or an external connector. Natural HIL intent never promotes a candidate, and only exact case-sensitive APPROVE may authorize Fuse on a genuinely write-capable governed host.
